# TSQLViz

> Experimental T-SQL visualization toolkit. Caller-supplied data becomes geometry
> displayed in SQL Server Management Studio's Spatial Results tab.

An AI agent can prepare reviewable SQL outside a restricted production environment.
A human reviews and transfers the artifact. Runtime requires preinstalled TSQLViz
Core + Charts, SQL Server 2017+ with compatibility level 140+, and SSMS (22 is the
primary tested viewer). Runtime has no AI/network integration. This is not a
zero-install mode. API/package currently 0.1.0-s5a; pin a revision and verify the
installed contracts. Main-branch links below can change.

## Agent workflow

- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/sasloz/TSQLViz/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository and artifact workflow.
- [Agent guide](https://github.com/sasloz/TSQLViz/blob/main/docs/agent-guide.md): API selection, units, context, limits, reviewable output.
- [Agent safety](https://github.com/sasloz/TSQLViz/blob/main/docs/agent-safety.md): restricted environment boundary and acquisition review.
- [Runnable agent examples](https://github.com/sasloz/TSQLViz/tree/main/examples/agents): synthetic charts and opt-in interval DMV acquisition.

## Authoritative contracts

- [Data contracts](https://github.com/sasloz/TSQLViz/blob/main/docs/data-contracts.md): identities, NULL, UTC, scene and context.
- [Type definitions](https://github.com/sasloz/TSQLViz/tree/main/src/core/types): exact columns, order, lengths and constraints.
- [Chart source](https://github.com/sasloz/TSQLViz/tree/main/src/charts): exact procedure signatures and validation.
- [Core reference](https://github.com/sasloz/TSQLViz/blob/main/src/core/README.md): geometry and scales.
- [Charts reference](https://github.com/sasloz/TSQLViz/blob/main/src/charts/README.md): layout and chart behavior.
- [Rendering](https://github.com/sasloz/TSQLViz/blob/main/docs/rendering.md): scene budgets and SSMS settings.

## Installation and validation

- [README](https://github.com/sasloz/TSQLViz/blob/main/README.md): installation, access and project status.
- [Development](https://github.com/sasloz/TSQLViz/blob/main/docs/development.md): builds and isolated tests.
- [Validation](https://github.com/sasloz/TSQLViz/blob/main/docs/validation.md): engine evidence and known visual limitations.
- [Query Store recipes](https://github.com/sasloz/TSQLViz/blob/main/examples/query-store/README.md): reviewed cross-database patterns and permissions.
